subject.title: Session hangs indefinitely when compaction times out, causing repeated duplicate message sends

question: Should #43661 remain a P0 satellite under #101863, or should maintainers split the remaining Telegram ambiguous-send and poisoned-session recovery work into a narrower canonical issue?
rationale: Current main partially mitigates compaction timeouts, but the remaining behavior spans product recovery UX and transport durability semantics that need maintainer ownership before a repair branch can be scoped safely.

options.title: Keep this P0 satellite
options.body: Leave #43661 open and linked to #101863 until end-to-end Telegram recovery proof closes the user-facing failure.

options.title: Split Telegram canonical
options.body: Move the Telegram ambiguous-send and restart-replay work into a narrower canonical issue and close this only after that issue carries the P0 impact labels and evidence.

options.title: Fold into umbrella
options.body: Close this issue only if maintainers explicitly accept losing the separate Telegram user-impact tracking signal.

recommendation.title: Keep this P0 satellite
recommendation.body: Leave #43661 open and linked to #101863 until end-to-end Telegram recovery proof closes the user-facing failure.

likelyOwner.reason: They own the referenced lifecycle umbrella where the unresolved run-abort, crash-resume, and completion-drive choices are being designed.
